名词性从句(二):主语从句与表语从句: 句子不仅能当宾语,还能当主语和表语;what 兼任"成分",that 只是"连接"。
主语从句:What he said surprised us.|It 作形式主语:It is clear that...|表语从句:The problem is that we are short of time.|what 在从句中作主语或宾语;that 只起连接作用|whether 可引导从句,if 一般不行
What she needs is a good rest.
It is true that prices went up.
The question is whether we can finish on time.
column3: 问题是我们能否按时完成。

名词性从句(二):主语从句与表语从句: That is why I called you.
column3: 这就是我给你打电话的原因。

名词性从句(二):主语从句与表语从句: Who wins the match matters little to me.
column3: 谁赢比赛对我来说不重要。

# title: ___ he said at the meeting made sense.
column4: 从句缺宾语(说了"什么"),用 what。

# title: ___ is a pity that you missed the show.
column4: It 作形式主语,真正主语是后面的从句。

# title: The problem is ___ we don't have enough hands.
That is ___ I chose the earlier train.
column4: why 引导表语从句,说明原因。

# title: ___ the plan will work is still unknown.
column4: 主语从句"是否"用 whether,不用 if。

# title: ___ you need is more practice, not more books.
column4: 从句缺宾语(需要"什么"),用 what。
